name: CalgaryDaily
confirmNote: Provisional kit. Replace the colours, handle and examples with CalgaryDaily's real ones before the first post goes out.

voice.summary: Bold, fast and clean. One strong headline, then the useful facts. Local news and things to do, never sensational.
examples: TODAY IN CALGARY: three free things to do before dinner.
Road closure on Memorial Drive this weekend. Here's what the City says and when it reopens.
New on the calendar: a year-round Wednesday farmers' market in Hillhurst.
rules: Use only facts supplied with the item or its source page. Never invent numbers, quotes or causes.
Always name the source (City of Calgary, organizer, venue) in the caption.
News about crime, collisions, fires or other emergencies always waits for human approval and never uses illustrated scenes.
No clickbait. The headline must be answerable by the caption.
